{{Quote|General Kenobi, a ship is approaching that matches the one Commander Skywalker followed into hyperspace. I have batteries standing by.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 20">{{CW|20}}</ref>}}
The '''''Ginivex''-class starfighters''', more commonly known as the '''Fanblade starfighters''', were six [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] constructed by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|agent]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and her cohorts on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Ginivex''-class were shaped like fans, that could stretch out a [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sail]], similar to the one on [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|Solar Sailer]]. They resembled aggressive Geonosian air patrol skimmers, and as a result, the ''Ginivex''-class starfighters were informally dubbed "Fanblades" for their most distinctive feature. The slim, elegant vessel had an iridescent fan-like wing extending from its dorsal and ventral surface. The wing could fold inward to hide flush with the ship's body.

[[File:Fanblade.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Asajj Ventress's ''Ginivex''-class starfighter]]

The Fanblades were armed with four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], two primary and two secondary. The two secondary cannons could swivel to the correct position, regardless of whether the fan was open or closed. In combat mode, these laser cannons had an enlarged firing arc. When the boom arms were shut, these cannons still pointed forward due to a limited hinge joint that locked them into place.

Though this combat mode greatly increased the fighter's target silhouette, the exotic material of the fan served as a transmission plane for [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] energy. With shields fully energized, the Fanblade was a tough target to hit. However, the energy output made the fighter stand out like a beacon on sensors.

In a manner similar to the sail found on Dooku's solar sailer, the fan also served as an alternate form of propulsion, though the ship was equipped with standard [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] drives. When not in combat mode, the starfighter lost the benefit of enhanced shields, but was difficult to target due to its tiny silhouette. Also, [[ion baffler]]s incorporated into its sublight engines made it very stealthy. At the head of the ship was the bulbous cockpit, designed for use only by [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] occupants.

When Fanblades landed, their sails would retract so that the ship could rest on the ventral laser cannons, as well as its front landing gear.

==History==
When Asajj Ventress became a disciple of Count Dooku, she had the sextet of fighters moved to her headquarters on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. Through the course of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], two of these fighters were stolen from Asajj, one by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and the other by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on Rattatak. Dooku later gave her a third, [[Last Call (Ginivex-class)|''Last Call'']], though this was destroyed on [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] by [[Palleus Chuff]].

During the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|battle]] at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], Ventress used another fighter to lead a strike force of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|tri-fighters]] to destroy Skywalker's flagship, the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], which was successful. She then chased General Kenobi before she crashed in the hangar of her own flagship, where Ventress called Dooku for assistance. However, he called back her reinforcements and renounced her as his apprentice, then her flagship was destroyed under the command of [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]]. Soon after, she was picked up in her damaged starfighter by scavengers aboard the [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']], which she hijacked and took to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] for help.

The Separatist officer [[Vulpus (individual)|Vulpus]] also used one for his meetings with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], near the climax of the Clone Wars, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] heard a rumor of Fanblade fighters taking part in the attack, but it is unclear whether this was actually the case.

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Ginivex is first depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' as well as its other comic appearances as having a physical solar sail extending from its wings, the ship's appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series instead depicts the sail as an energy construct similar to a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]].

An artwork of Ventress' ''Ginivex''-class starfighter was included in the [[2007]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|Starships of the Galaxy]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="SotGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> The artwork for the book was drawn by [[Mark Tedin]]<ref name="TedinFile">{{WookCite|url=File:GinivexClassStarfighterSotG.jpg?oldid=2178219|text=January 27, 2008 revision of File:GinivexClassStarfighterSotG.jpg}}</ref> under a contract with [[Lucasfilm]] and Wizards of the Coast. As he didn't know the animation from ''Clone Wars'', Tedin mistakenly drew the starfighter's laser bolts as green instead of red, but the error was corrected before the book's publication.<ref name="Bantha68">{{WookCite|url=User_talk:Bantha68|text=User talk page for {{U|Bantha68}}}}</ref>
